title: The Note in the Tube
lines: Jane, Pete and Dad walk up to the lake.
Pete finds a tube stuck in the mud.
A note is in it, and a small map.
"Nine steps from the pine," said Jane.
They dig by the pine, but get just sand.
"My steps are small," said Jane. "Nine big steps!"
Jane walks nine wide steps and digs there.
Pete lifts up a white stone. He grins.
"Hide it for the next kid," said Jane.
So they did, and left a note in it.

questions.ask: What does Pete find stuck in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A tube, with a note and a small map in it.

questions.ask: Why did they get just sand the first time they dug?
questions.listenFor: Jane works it out: her steps were small, so nine of them did not go far. She walks nine big, wide steps and digs there.

questions.ask: They left a note in the tube for the next kid. What else could they have left?
questions.listenFor: Any idea. The tube held a note and a small map in line three. Ask what would be fun to find.
